sloka: द्विजैरभिविनीतश्च श्रेष्ठैर्धर्मार्थनैपुणैः ।यदा व्रजति संग्रामं ग्रामार्थे नगरस्य वा ॥२-२-३६॥
transliteration: dvijairabhivinītaśca śreṣṭhairdharmārthanaipuṇaiḥ ।yadā vrajati saṁgrāmaṁ grāmārthe nagarasya vā ॥2-2-36॥

translations.english: Whenever he, wellinstructed in all matters by the best of brahmins wellversed in dharma and artha proceeds along with Lakshmana to wage a war for the sake of a village or a town, he never returns without conquering the enemy.
